rozhledna-janov.title: Janov Lookout Tower
rozhledna-janov.summary: The steel tower from 2013 stands right in the village. A hundred and sixty-two steps lead to a 360° view over Bohemian and Saxon Switzerland.

bunkry-janov.title: Janov Bunkers
bunkry-janov.summary: A loop past the pre-war border bunkers of the 1930s. Forest tracks lead from the village to several well-preserved pillboxes with information boards.

hrensko.title: Hřensko
hrensko.summary: The lowest-lying village in Czechia and the gateway to the national park. Walks to the Kamenice gorges and to Pravčická brána start here.

ruzovsky-vrch.title: Růžovský vrch Hill
ruzovsky-vrch.summary: A basalt summit at 619 m with cuttings that open onto the wider country. The yellow trail from Hřensko to Srbská Kamenice leads up from Janov.

pravcicka-brana.title: Pravčická brána Arch
pravcicka-brana.summary: The largest sandstone arch in Europe - 26.5 metres high. The Falcon's Nest viewing terrace and its restaurant sit right beneath it.
pravcicka-brana.note: The red Gabriela's Path has stayed closed since the 2022 fire, so the route detours via Tři prameny. Check the current status on npcs.cz before you set out.

divoka-soutesky.title: Wild Gorge (Divoká soutěska)
divoka-soutesky.summary: A punt ride through the Kamenice canyon between walls up to 150 metres high. The boats run from Easter to the end of October.
divoka-soutesky.note: The route passes through Edmund's Gorge, which closes at times for rock stabilisation. You will find the current status on soutesky.cz.

mezni-louka.title: Mezní Louka
mezni-louka.summary: A hamlet in the middle of the park and the main junction of trails. A roomy car park, a bus from Děčín, and waymarks heading off in every direction.

labska-vyhlidka.title: Elbe Viewpoint (Belvedere)
labska-vyhlidka.summary: A rock terrace 130 metres above a bend in the Elbe. The Prince's Path from Bynovec is easy enough for children, and there is usually a refreshment stand at the top.

rozhledna-ruzenka.title: Růženka Lookout Tower
rozhledna-ruzenka.summary: A concrete tower on Pastevní vrch whose shape recalls Kaplický's library design. It is a short walk from Růžová and entry is free.

dolsky-mlyn.title: Dolský mlýn Mill Ruin
dolsky-mlyn.summary: The ruin of a 16th-century mill on the bank of the Kamenice, the oldest in the park. The path drops through the river valley in the shade of the forest.

mala-pravcicka-brana.title: Little Pravčická brána
mala-pravcicka-brana.summary: The smaller sister of the famous arch, hidden deep in the forest. Yellow waymarks lead to the Pod Šaunštejnem junction, then red - no entry fee and no queues.

saunstejn.title: Šaunštejn Rock Castle
saunstejn.summary: A 14th-century rock castle, later a robbers' den. The final stretch climbs ladders fixed in the rock - pick another target in rain or ice.

rudolfuv-kamen.title: Rudolfův kámen Viewpoint
rudolfuv-kamen.summary: A viewpoint on a sandstone tor at 484 metres. The climb finishes on metal ladders and steps cut into the rock.

vileminina-stena.title: Vilemínina stěna Viewpoint
vileminina-stena.summary: The most photogenic viewpoint of the Jetřichovice walls, perched on the edge of an almost vertical face. The gentle forest climb suits less experienced walkers.

mariina-vyhlidka.title: Mariina vyhlídka Viewpoint
mariina-vyhlidka.summary: A railed rock spur with a view sweeping more than 180 degrees. The walk from Jetřichovice is moderate and ends on steps cut into the rock.

falkenstejn.title: Falkenštejn Rock Castle
falkenstejn.summary: A 13th-century rock castle whose name means Falcon's Stone. The way up threads narrow clefts and staircases carved into the sandstone.

trpaslici-skaly.title: Trpasličí skály (Dwarf Rocks)
trpaslici-skaly.summary: A labyrinth of rock passages, towers and overhangs - a miniature of the great rock towns. Allow at least two hours to explore every corner.

pavlinino-udoli.title: Pavlínino údolí Valley
pavlinino-udoli.summary: The valley of the Chřibská Kamenice from Jetřichovice down to the hamlet of Všemily. Almost no climbing, so a less fit group will manage it.

kyjovske-udoli.title: Kyjovské údolí Valley
kyjovske-udoli.summary: A nature trail through the Křinice valley with wooden walkways and bridges over the stream. Easy going and suitable for every age.

decinsky-sneznik.title: Sněžník Lookout Tower
decinsky-sneznik.summary: The oldest stone lookout tower in Bohemia, built in 1864 and 33 metres tall. From the platform the view runs from the Ore Mountains to the Krkonoše.

tiske-steny.title: Tiské stěny Rock Town
tiske-steny.summary: A rock town with a Large and a Small circuit; The Chronicles of Narnia was filmed here. The circuits inside the rocks alone take two to three hours.
